audit.why: Favoured early lane, falls off at two items — diff FAVOURED 4/10 matches the 54.22% WR over 640 games and the level chart (Pantheon 1 through first item, Viktor at 2+ items).
Spikes at level 2 (W stun), 3-5 all-in, 6 Grand Starfall, first item; Viktor spikes on augments and 2+ items. spikes[] has all 4 entries and matches the chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer names Viktor's R 'Chaos Storm' throughout; Riot's kit file says Arcane Storm. spikes[0] calls Gravity Field '(E, later W)' — Gravity Field is his W (17s rank 1) and Hextech Ray is E (12s). breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names and cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Arcane Storm (R), Gravity Field (W, 17/16/15/14/13s), Hextech Ray (E, 12/11/10/9/8s), Siphon Power (Q, 9-5s, shield + auto reset).

audit.whatIsWrong: Gravity Field named as the defining cooldown but no duration given anywhere.
audit.why: 17s at rank 1 is a long, punishable window.
audit.corrected: Fight in the 17s after Gravity Field drops.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Title promises one thing, body says another.
audit.corrected: Rewritten bodies specific to their titles.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field (W): 17s at rank 1, 13s max — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it; its downtime is your all-in window. - His Hextech Ray (E) runs 12s early. - Your E Aegis Assault (22s) is for the moment it goes wrong; R (180s) for the moment it goes right.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At level 2 he has no dash and no Gravity Field rank worth fearing — W-stun and cash empowered Q free.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-first-item his Siphon Power shield and 12s Hextech Ray win any 525-range poke war — force point-blank fights or take none at all.

edits.before: You must snowball this window before Viktor stacks his upgrades: he has no dash and only Gravity Field (E, later W) to peel, so W-stun into empowered Q on top of him is a near-guaranteed chunk or kill. Punish every Siphon Power (Q) shield he throws by trading while it's on cooldown, and keep the wave pushing so he can't safely last-hit.
edits.after: You must snowball this window before Viktor stacks his upgrades: he has no dash and only Gravity Field (W, 17s cooldown) to peel, so W-stun into empowered Q on top of him is a near-guaranteed chunk or kill. Punish every Siphon Power (Q) shield he throws by trading in its 9s cooldown, and keep the wave pushing so he can't safely last-hit.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you: your Grand Starfall all-in beats his zone-control Chaos Storm while he's still squishy.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you: your Grand Starfall all-in beats his zone-control Arcane Storm while he's still squishy.

edits.before: Two-plus items favour Viktor: fully upgraded, he out-ranges you and his E laser plus Chaos Storm shred you before you reach him.
edits.after: Two-plus items favour Viktor: fully upgraded, he out-ranges you and his E laser plus Arcane Storm shred you before you reach him.

edits.before: At 6 your Grand Starfall gives you a hard all-in while Viktor's upgraded Chaos Storm (R) is a zone-control ult, not a self-peel; leap onto him and combo before the storm can chase. He's still immobile and squishy here, so keep diving him and deny the CS he needs to complete his components.
edits.after: At 6 your Grand Starfall gives you a hard all-in while Viktor's Arcane Storm (R, 120s) is a zone-control ult, not a self-peel; leap onto him and combo before the storm can chase. He's still immobile and squishy here, so keep diving him and deny the CS he needs to complete his components.

edits.before: Viktor is a scaling monster: once his components are upgraded he out-ranges you, his upgraded E laser and Chaos Storm shred you before you reach him, and Gravity Field locks your engage. Stop face-checking his zone; group with your team and force him to fight where his poke can't kite your all-in.
edits.after: Viktor is a scaling monster: once his components are upgraded he out-ranges you, his upgraded E laser and Arcane Storm shred you before you reach him, and Gravity Field locks your engage. Stop face-checking his zone; group with your team and force him to fight where his poke can't kite your all-in.

edits.before: After first item you still burst him, but the clock is against you: two-plus items turn Viktor into a long-range zone controller whose upgraded E, Chaos Storm, and Gravity Field out-damage and lock you before you connect. Convert your early lead into towers and objectives and avoid dueling him once he's online.
edits.after: After first item you still burst him, but the clock is against you: two-plus items turn Viktor into a long-range zone controller whose upgraded E, Arcane Storm, and Gravity Field out-damage and lock you before you connect. Convert your early lead into towers and objectives and avoid dueling him once he's online.

edits.before: Reaching two-plus items where his range and Chaos Storm out-damage you
edits.after: Reaching two-plus items where his range and Arcane Storm out-damage you

notes: Kit flag marks Viktor R as 'channel' but Riot's own description says Arcane Storm INTERRUPTS enemy channels, not that it is one — trusted the description and did NOT write the auto-generated 'your W cancels his R' missing-interaction. His R does threaten your E Aegis Assault channel (it interrupts channels) — left unwritten because I could not verify from the kit whether the interrupt applies to Aegis specifically; recorded here rather than speculating. Gravity Field stun will cancel your E channel — covered implicitly by existing fight-outside-it advice. Level chart consistent across layers; no chart edits.
